newsitem.title: FRANCE: Publicis wins Thomson Multmedia ad budget.
newsitem.headline: Publicis wins Thomson Multmedia ad budget.

text.p: French advertising group Publicis said on Tuesday it was awarded the advertising budget for Thomson Multimedia in France and Europe against competition from other agencies.
It gave no figure for the budget.
Publicis said in a statement it was competing with Ogilvy & Mather, McCann Erikson, Young & Rubicam, Grey and J.Walter Thomson for the contract.
Thomson Multimedia is a subsidiary of France's Thomson SA .
